analyst_view.overall: Early view: Hajduk Split (13th, six points) beat Ajax 2-1 and won 1-0 at Thun before a surprise 1-0 defeat in Gibraltar against Lincoln Red Imps. Sint-Truiden (10th, seven points) are unbeaten in Europe with one goal conceded, but in Belgium they are 16th and lost three league games in a row between 11 October and 1 November, all high-scoring. A full Poljud should make this a demanding trip.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. I lean lower: Hajduk's three European games produced three, one and one goals, and Sint-Truiden's 2-0, 1-0 and 1-1 show a team that defends far better in Europe than in their league. Sint-Truiden's open domestic games (losses of 4-3, 3-2 and 2-1) are the risk to this view.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.4 corners, split evenly. I read nothing that moves this.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards. I lean a little higher: Hajduk at home will push hard after the Lincoln defeat, a close game between two sides on six and seven points tends to be scrappy, and a hostile Poljud crowd usually adds pressure on the visitors.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.9 shots. Hajduk should have more of the ball at home, but the site already allows for that; I see nothing to move the total.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.0 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: both sides have kept European games tight and low-scoring, which usually means fewer clean chances.
